parsed.evidence_quote: The effectiveness of the newly established platform has been demonstrated using three commercially available and non-cleavable NHS ester-haloacetamide heterobifunctional cross-linkers to map in vivo PPIs from HEK 293 cells.
coupled on-line to an Orbitrap FusionTM LumosTM mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher, San Jose, CA)
The step-HCD MS2 acquisition method was used for the identification of cross-linked peptides. Ions with a charge of 4+ to 8+ in the MS1 scan were selected for MS2 analysis.
The cross-linked peptides were also analyzed by step-HCD MS2... Collision-induced dissociation (CID) analysis of oxidized and alkylated Ac-LR9 triggered a neutral loss of 107 Da
HCD MS2 scans had a normalized collision energy of 27 with a step of ±6
we performed MS2-based analysis for 2 SIA replicates, 3 SIAB replicates and 3 SBAP replicates
